tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bkra shis chos sder mgon po'i rab gnas skabs kyi reg zig/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes chen 'gran med bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang / de nyid kyi dgongs rdzogs dngul gdung rin po che'i mtha' 'khor na bzhugs pa'i bla brgyud 'di rnams gur gyi mgon po'i chos bskor yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud rim yin pas 'di nyid gtso bor byas/ dgon gnas 'di na rang re'i grub mtha' gtsang ma'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung nor lha'i sku byin can kho na bzhugs/ gsung rten thugs rten phon chen 'don/ chos bskang ba phyag len phra mo tshun chad rang lugs rkyang pa yin pas srid mtha'i bar du brten phyir ngos gsum nas rdo rje/ phur pa bde kyai gsang gsum gyis rab gnas 'bring po bya/ rab ston dngos gzhi gur mgon la brten kyang / da lam mgon khang min pas 'don pa rab gnas don gnyis lhun grub sor bzhag la ma lus sems can ma'i 'gor thams cad longs/ bcom dung rkang gling g.yab dar/ dung chen/ gu gul gyi dud pa shin tu che ba/ bcom rol dang ring lugs dril gsil g.yab dar bcas/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang chen mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur/ /bram ze mchog sred bde ba'i rdo rje dang / /shrardhāka ra warma rin chen bzang / /yon tan tshul khrims la sogs gshegs su gsol/ /blo gros grags dang rje btsun sa skya pa/ /kun dga' snying po bsod nams rtse mo dang / /grags pa rgyal mtshan sa skya paṇḍita/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa la sogs gshegs su gsol/ /la dbyangs rol tshar bzhi/ dam pa kun grags bdag nyid chen po dang / /bsod nams rgyal mtshan bla chen kun dga'i mtshan/ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rgya gar shes bzang dang / /kun dga' bsod nams la sogs gshegs su gsol/ /kun dga' rin chen bsod nams dbang po dang / /grags pa blo gros kun dga' bsod nams zhabs/

/bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis dang / /rin chen ratna'i mtshan can gshegs su gsol/ /tshig rol/ blo gros rgyal mtshan kun bzang chos kyi nyi/ /blo gsal rgya mtsho mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang / /gzhon nu blo gros bod mkhar rta ra ba/ /bslab gsum dbang phyug rab brtan gshegs su gsol/ /bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub dang / /mkhyen rab byams pa rmor chen rdo rje 'chang / /snyigs dus lung rtogs bstan dang sa skya pa'i/ /snyan brgyud mnga' bdag mtshungs med bka' drin can/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos ngag dbang kun tu dga'/ /legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i bdag /rgyal mtshan dpal ldan bzang po'i mtshan mnga' ba/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan mgon po gshegs tshig rol su gsol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun 'dus shing / /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ngo bo nyid/ /chos skyong kun gyi phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /de 'dra gang yin bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /chos sku mkha' khyab pho brang lhun grub nas/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes gang 'dul skur ston cing / /bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /mgon po lha mo kun gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus tshod 'dir/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ni ngan na yang / /shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'dir gshegs nas dngos grub ma lus stsol/ tshig rol chems brdung gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ /na mo gu ru sa pā ri wā re bhyaḥs mā dza ཿ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka he badzra sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā la de bī/ tsa turmu kha/ badzra kā la yakṣa/ ka li yakṣi ṇi/ yakṣa pu tra ru tra bha ṭa/ ru lu rakṣa se sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ

padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ ma lus sems can man 'dra/ cho ga yongs rdzogs grub nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kyai rdor sogs bzhag la me 'bar ba'i dbus su dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su sogs gtor bsngo sor bzhag dmigs med sogs/ ma lus sogs/ oṃ e hye hi shrī ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya artsa sogs/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ sngon tshe rdo rje sogs/ oṃ badzra gau rī sogs/ dbang lha spyan 'dren sogs nas/ yar lud pa las bar 'dra/ gur gyi mgon po la rnam par snang mdzad/ gzhan rnams la gur gyi mgon pos dbur brgyan/ lha thams cad sogs 'dra/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gsum sngon 'gro'i byon zan sogs dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa pā ri wā ra ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā sogs 'dra/ mtshan sngags nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi sogs/ 'bul tshan la yi ge bdun ma sngon 'gro'i rdzas sngags sogs/ dri med yid du la mtshan sngags gong bzhin/ bla brgyud/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrardhā ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng ba yon tan tshul khrims/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rjes sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags pa/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chen po nas drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar kyai rdor bzhin/ gzhan 'dra/ dril gsil gyis srin gzugs shlau ka gcig kun tu bzang po'i rig ma las/ /ma g.yos u ma de ba'i sku/ /ma mo thams cad skyed mdzad pa/

/yum chen khyod la bdag bstod do/ /gang sku mgon po'i bka' nyan nag po/ nag mo/ dpal ldan phrin las/ 'jigs byed dbyings/ sngon tshe gsang / mgon po'i bka' nyan lus mkhan ma rungs pa rnams shlau ka re/ gtor ma byin brlabs kyai rdor bzhin/ 'bul sngags nas/ de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog bar rgyun bzhin/ de 'phros kyai rdor sbyin sreg bzhin/ gong 'og thams cad kyi spel tshig ni/ yul 'di'i gdan sa khyad par can rten brten pa bla ma dge 'dun sbyin bdag sogs snod bcud rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad dang / rab gnas cho ga rnam lnga'i lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā// //zhes so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ bkra shis chos sder mgon po'i rab gnas skabs kyi reg zig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
